about.title: About
about.description1: I'm a Middle Fullstack Developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications. My journey started with systems analysis and has evolved into full-stack development, where I've successfully delivered 15+ production applications for clients across various industries.
about.description2: My core strength lies in full-stack development with expertise in C#/.NET, ReactJS, Node.js, and Next.js. On the backend, I design and implement robust RESTful APIs using .NET Core (versions 3.1 and 6) and Node.js with Express/NestJS, Entity Framework for data access, and maintain clean architecture patterns. I'm experienced with multiple databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and MongoDB, choosing the right tool for each project's needs.
about.description3: On the frontend, I build responsive and performant applications using React with modern hooks, state management, and component architecture, as well as Next.js for server-side rendering and optimized performance. I focus on creating maintainable code, optimizing performance, and ensuring excellent user experiences. I'm also comfortable with Angular for enterprise applications, JavaScript/TypeScript, and have worked with various UI libraries and styling approaches including Tailwind CSS.
about.description4: Beyond coding, I bring strong problem-solving skills, experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and the ability to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines. I've led small teams as a TechLead, conducted code reviews, and mentored junior developers. My English level is B2 (Efset 52), enabling effective communication in international teams.
about.description5: I'm actively seeking middle fullstack opportunities where I can take ownership of features from design to deployment, work with modern tech stacks (C#/.NET, React, Node.js, Next.js, and more), and contribute to meaningful products. I'm particularly interested in roles that leverage my diverse technical expertise while allowing me to grow into more senior responsibilities.

pandaloyalty.title: PandaLoyalty - Customer Management Website
pandaloyalty.summary: Customer loyalty platform to manage members, points, rewards, and omnichannel integrations.
pandaloyalty.problem: Manual reward workflows and fragmented POS/CRM data across partners.
pandaloyalty.challenge: During integration with KiotViet POS system, I faced API rate limiting issues that caused transaction failures during peak hours. The system needed to handle 500+ concurrent requests while maintaining data consistency across multiple partner systems.
pandaloyalty.solution: I implemented a retry mechanism with exponential backoff and created a queue system using .NET Core Background Services. I also added caching for frequently accessed partner data and implemented circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures. Collaborated with the team lead to design the architecture and received code review feedback.
pandaloyalty.outcome: Automated reward redemption and streamlined integrations, reducing manual operations for client teams. System now handles 1000+ requests/minute with 99.5% success rate.
pandaloyalty.linksNote: Demo and repo are available upon request.

mfott.title: MFOTT Elearning
mfott.summary: E-learning platform for employee skills training: role-based access, course assignment, evaluation, and reporting.
mfott.problem: The business needed a centralized system to manage internal training, user permissions, and employee learning progress.
mfott.challenge: Multiple interconnected modules (courses, permissions, evaluation, reporting, email) in a microservice architecture required reliable data sync via message queues and efficient stored procedure calls.
mfott.solution: Built with microservice and DDD patterns using .NET Core 3 backend and Angular 8 frontend. Integrated RabbitMQ for async communication, email notifications, and stored procedures for complex business logic. Used Postman for API testing during development.
mfott.outcome: Delivered course assignment, employee evaluation, and training reports with flexible permissions and automated email notifications.
mfott.linksNote: Demo and repo are available upon request.

congLuongCom.title: Management for Work, Wages, and Meals
congLuongCom.summary: Software for managing gold warehouse production stages: stage tracking, gold quality control, and productivity by personnel.
congLuongCom.problem: Gold warehouse production workflows were fragmented, making it hard to track quality and stage productivity by staff.
congLuongCom.challenge: Needed to model multiple production stages, manage gold quality, and measure productivity by person while keeping queries performant on MySQL and SQL Server.
congLuongCom.solution: Built a fullstack app with React and .NET 9, using MySQL and SQL Server for data storage. Deployed on Azure and used Postman to test APIs and validate stage workflows.
congLuongCom.outcome: Enabled production stage tracking, gold quality control, and personnel productivity reporting on Azure.
congLuongCom.linksNote: Demo and repo are available upon request.
